What Adam Smith Missed

Nov 20, 2026

Mordecai Kurz

For all that he got right, the "founding father" of economics failed to see how technological innovations lead to market monopolization. If AI is left to the invisible hand, it will almost certainly increase economic and political inequality, causing even deeper social polarization and further undermining democracy.

STANFORD—This year marked the 250th anniversary of the publication of Adam Smith’s The Wealth of Nations, a book that remains widely—and deservedly—celebrated. But this moment in economic history demands that we address one of Smith’s gravest and most consequential errors.
